sloka: ततः खड्गं समुद्यम्य त्रिशिरा राक्षसोत्तमः।निजघान तदा व्यूढे वायुपुत्रस्य वक्षसि ।। ६.७०.४१ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ khaḍgaṁ samudyamya triśirā rākṣasottamaḥ।nijaghāna tadā vyūḍhe vāyuputrasya vakṣasi ।। 6.70.41 ।।

translations.english: Trisira, the foremost of Rakshasas then lifted his sword, placed it on the chest of Hanuman and dug into it.
